info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of documents associated with mortgage loans, enabling users to access critical information regarding their loans. It serves mortgage professionals, financial institutions, and borrowers by providing a streamlined method for document management and retrieval. Users can query the API to obtain necessary documentation, ensuring transparency and accessibility in the mortgage process. This capability aids in improving the efficiency of loan processing and enhances customer service in the mortgage sector.

get.description: This operation allows users to fetch all relevant documents associated with loans, providing access to crucial information needed for loan management and processing.

requestBody.description: This JSON request body is required for retrieving documents related to loans. Please ensure that the correct schema is followed to facilitate a successful response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loan documents.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation of the loans documents API. It is intended to be a string that encapsulates the necessary data required for processing the GET request.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsResponse_200.title: Loan Documents Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the loan document.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the loan document.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Optional message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit trail of the operation.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the successful retrieval of loan documents.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the document.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the document was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information about the operation.
